title: WPSB/585/2021 of MRITYUNJAY SHARMA Vs STATE OF UTTARAKHAND

COURT'S OR JUDGES'S ORDERS
WPSB No.585 of 2021
Sh r i Man oj Ku m ar Tiw ar i, J.
Sh r i Ram esh Ch an d r a Kh u lb e, J.
Mr. Anil Kumar Joshi, learned counsel for
the petitioner.
Mr. C.S. Rawat, learned C.S.C. along
with Mr. S.S. Chaudhary, learned B.H. for the
State- respondents.
Petitioner was appointed as Assistant
Professor in Government Degree College,
Uttarkashi through State Public Service
Commission, in the year 2005. He is
aggrieved by order passed by the State
Government on 11.11.2021, whereby, he has
been transferred from Government Degree
College, Rishikesh to Government Degree
College, Thailisain, District Pauri Garhwal.
Besides questioning the transfer order,
petitioner has also sought a writ of
mandamus directing respondents not to take
any further action pursuant to the im pugned
order dated 11.11.2021.
I t is not in dispute that Govt. Degree
College, Rishikesh has become a Campus
College of Sridev Suman Uttarakhand
University, Badshahithaul, Tehri Garhwal,
which is established under 'Sridev Suman
Uttarakhand University Act, 2011'.
Petitioner has challenged his transfer
from Rishikesh to Thalisain on the ground that
on 04.08.2019, when decision was taken by
State Government to declare P.G. College,
Rishikesh as Campus College of Sri Dev
Suman Uttarakhand University, petitioner was
serving at Rishikesh as Associate Professor,
therefore, he became teacher of the
University from the said date. He further
contends that initially, option for absorption in

the University was invited only from
Government Teachers serving in the College
at Rishikesh, however, subsequently,
Government Teachers serving elsewhere were
also asked to give their option.
This, according to petitioner, is
impermissible, as anyone, who is not serving
at Rishikesh could not have been asked to
give option for becoming employee of the
University.
I n the counter affidavit filed on behalf of
respondent nos. 1 & 2, it has been contended
that petitioner does not become employee of
the University merely by issuance of order
dated 04.08.2019, whereby administrative
sanction of the State Government was
granted for converting Governm ent P.G.
College, Rishikesh, as Campus College of the
University. I t is further contended that
teaching and non-teaching staff of all
Government Colleges were entitled for equal
opportunity for absorption in the University,
established recently, therefore, petitioner
cannot capitalise on his posting at Rishikesh
on 04.08.2019, when the order granting
administrative sanction for conversion of
Government College, as Campus College of
the University, was given.
I n para 5 of the counter affidavit,
impugned transfer order has been defended
by contending that petitioner is employee of
Higher Education Department and not of the
University Services of English teacher are
urgently needed at Thalisain, therefore,
petitioner was transferred to Thalisain.
The defence taken by respondent is
plausible. As Govt. Teacher, petitioner is
liable to be posted in any Government
College. Petitioner has not been absorbed in
University Service, therefore, there is no
illegality in the impugned transfer order.

The contention m ade on behalf of the
petitioner that he was posted in concerned
College on the date when State Government
gave adm inistrative control of the College to
the University, therefore, his services
autom atically got absorbed in the University,
is unacceptable.
Perusal of Government Order dated
04.08.2019 reveals that only administrative
control of Governm ent P.G. College, Rishikesh
was handed over to the University to meet
the immediate requirement of the University,
however, the said order is absolutely silent as
regards teaching and non-teaching staff.
Merely because a Government College
became Campus College of the University
does not mean that all employees, teaching
and non-teaching, serving in the College, will
autom atically become employee of the
University.
 Petitioner has challenged the transfer
order on a wrong premise that he is employee
of the University, therefore, cannot be
transferred by Director, Higher Education,
therefore, the challenge thrown by petitioner
to the transfer order is unsustainable. I n the
absence of any order of absorption passed in
respect of petitioner by the University,
petitioner cannot be treated as em ployee of
the University.
Thus, Director, Higher Education was
justified in transferring petitioner from
Rishikesh to Thailisain.
I n such view of the matter, we do not
find any reason to interfere with the transfer
order passed in respect of petitioner.
Learned counsel appearing for the
petitioner then submitted that petitioner m ay
be permitted to make representation to the
Competent Authority for change of place of
his posting in view of his personal difficulties.
I n view of the prayer so made, the writ

petition is disposed of with liberty to
petitioner to m ake representation seeking
change of place of his posting through e-mail
to the Secretary, Higher Education, within 48
hours. I f petitioner m akes such
representation within stipulated time, decision
thereupon shall be taken within two weeks
thereafter.
Till decision is taken on petitioner's
representation, he shall not be relieved from
Rishikesh. I t is, however, made clear that if
petitioner fails to make representation within
stipulated time, then he will not be entitled to
protection of this order.
Pending application, if any, stands
disposed of.

( R.C. Kh u lb e, J.) ( Man oj Ku m ar Tiw ar i J.)
25.05.2022
R.Bisht
